notes: Funding is institution-specific (CSHL endowment pays all tuition and provides a ~$50,000/yr stipend), so the supervising pool is the SBS Research Faculty listed on the Ph.D. Programme's own faculty page. Max 3 professors recorded. NOTE ON EMAILS: CSHL publishes addresses behind Cloudflare email protection; the address is embedded in, and rendered from, the institutional profile page itself (data-cfemail attribute), e.g. lippman@cshl.edu, trotman@cshl.edu, zador@cshl.edu - no address was guessed or constructed. NOTE ON AVAILABILITY: the programme admits centrally, per the official FAQ ('All students must be admitted through the Program; an individual professor cannot offer a student admission to the School'), and students later join a research lab ('Once students join a research lab, they receive an $2,000 per year research cost allowance, intended to help support their thesis work, paid to their lab'), so these are potential thesis supervisors rather than pre-assigned supervisors. The SBS Research Faculty page states 'Current faculty members lead cutting-edge laboratories in a broad range of topics.'
